course_name_original: UE4 - L3SPI-M5BLC - base du langage C/C++ méca
course_name_en: UE4 - L3SPI-M5BLC - C/C++ language fundamentals for mechanics
assessment_rules: For the main session, the overall grade is calculated with a coefficient of 1.5 for continuous assessment (written and/or oral), 3 for the terminal written exam, and 1.5 for the continuous assessment practical test. For the resit session, a written terminal exam is given (coefficient 3) and the grades from continuous assessment (coefficient 1.5) and the practical test (coefficient 1.5) are carried over.
degree: Licence Sciences pour l'ingénieur, parcours Mécanique (UFR Sciences et Techniques)
